title: liquiditybot — incidents
description: Faults, rejects and self-heal signals for the liquiditybot paper-trading engine. Complementary to 'liquiditybot — control'.

panels.title: Op-state
panels.description: Central fault authority (core/fault.py). 0 ARMED nominal · 1 DEGRADED no-new-risk · 2 HALTED flatten-and-stop. -1 UNKNOWN = the field is absent (old runner). Exits ALWAYS run regardless.

panels.title: Latched faults
panels.description: Number of faults currently latched in the fault authority. >0 means the op-state is DEGRADED/HALTED until an operator clears them or restarts.

panels.title: Audit torn-tails
panels.description: Torn final audit lines recovered on startup (crash mid-append). Rising = the process is being killed mid-write repeatedly (unclean stops).

panels.title: Runner
panels.description: 1 = loop RUNNING

panels.title: Kill-switch level
panels.description: ML governor: 0 ok / 1 degraded / 2 model killed

panels.title: Entries
panels.description: new-risk gate

panels.title: Halted
panels.description: capital hard-stop

panels.title: Firewall fault
panels.description: 15c3-5 screen latched a fault

panels.title: Status age
panels.description: freshness of status.json; climbs if the runner freezes

panels.title: Kraken WS
panels.description: live book stream (REST fallback if down)

panels.title: WS reconnects
panels.description: cumulative; a rising count = flapping feed

panels.title: Marks age
panels.description: oldest live mark; climbs the instant a price stops updating

panels.title: ML faults (cumulative — rising = a subsystem dying)
ML fault counters
panels.description: each rise = the model or a feature block degraded to prior/neutral. Flat is healthy.

panels.title: Retrain failures
panels.description: auto-retrain threw; a rising number = stale champion kept forever

panels.title: Model fallbacks
panels.description: inferences served the prior instead of the model

panels.title: Feature drift share
panels.description: Fraction of MARKET features past PSI 0.25 (clock/counter features excluded). Transient blips self-heal via auto-retrain; the alert rule only pings when this stays >0.30 for 30m WHILE the governor kill-switch (monitor_level) is degraded/killed. The 0.30 line is the retrain-vote threshold.

panels.title: Firewall rejects/clamps by code
panels.description: per-code FW tallies: rate-limit, dupe, notional/collar reject or clamp, fault-reject

panels.title: Order-manager rejects
panels.description: venue refused an order / dead-man refresh failing (precedes Kraken auto-cancelling all resting orders)

panels.title: Dead-man failures
panels.description: >=3 escalates; the switch that cancels resting orders is failing to refresh

panels.title: Reason-code frequency (why decisions go the way they do)
Code emissions by family
panels.description: cumulative count of every reason code by prefix — SZ sizer, PT pre-trade, RP risk-protocol, FW firewall, OM orders, ML, VN, TH. A jump in RP = budget/heat exhaustion stopping entries.

panels.title: Code totals
panels.description: current cumulative totals per code family

panels.title: Drawdown & equity drift
panels.description: drift = book vs recomputed equity mismatch (reconciliation health)

panels.title: Watchdog trips
panels.description: infrastructure sentry: each trip blocks new entries

panels.title: Audit dropped writes
panels.description: hash-chained audit records lost to disk errors (chain holes)

panels.title: WS books cached
panels.description: live cached order books (should equal traded-pair count)

panels.title: Exit-eval failures
panels.description: Cumulative per-position stop/tier evaluations that RAISED and were isolated (fast_cycle). >0 = a book position is wedging its own escape path — investigate that position.

panels.title: Cycle failures (streak)
panels.description: Consecutive whole-cycle (cycle_once) failures. At cycle_fail_halt (10) the runner latches a new-risk halt and alerts. Nonzero = the loop is degraded right now.
